responsibility: Collects the public declarations for the IA-64 backend and its subtargets so target macros, md files, and other compiler components can call into ia64.cc and companion code. The prototypes cover operand expansion helpers, prologue/epilogue and frame logic, call and atomic expansion, builtin lowering, vector permutation support, assembler-output hooks, unwind and return-address helpers, profiling support, and HP-UX/VMS-specific entry points.
